counter_definition.fixed_mmap_attempts: actual per-piece libc MAP_FIXED call attempts, including a failed attempt; initial PROT_NONE reservation EXCLUDED
counter_definition.validated_pieces_offered: input pieces after complete geometry validation, before reservation; may exceed attempts on an early failure
counter_definition.denominator: one complete per-space synchronous target_apply, not whole Batch/request wall
counter_definition.outer_mark_calls: Reservations::mark invocations, not inner Live::mark/allocation count
counter_definition.stitch_calls: whole stitch invocations, not inner mmap count
counter_definition.time_per_call: whole stitch_ns divided by fixed attempts: overhead-inclusive AMORTIZED cost, NOT measured individual syscall latency
counter_definition.signals: enabled; timed intervals and subsequent behavior can be perturbed

coverage.scope: conditional valid target_apply>500ms emissions; not all refreshes or per-call latency distribution

stopping_rule.before_run: first complete valid H row>500ms after launch frontier, independent of count/value/refusal, then fixed60s observation tail
stopping_rule.limits: 60s is observation tail, not physical process cutoff; capture/handoff/cleanup time is separate and all rows retained

interpretation: observed tens of thousands of actual fixed mmap attempts in both windows; 98304 attempts and20.404us amortized in the larger window, not an assumed90000 or28us; no fix or unpaired performance comparison

source_read.answer: temporary host CPU view is synchronously consumed by RM OS-descriptor allocation before GPU map; later CPU-view cleanup is normally deferred, not awaited by completion
source_read.limits: source reading, not installed-driver pin-lifetime or universal release proof

invocation.flags: same23 A7418 flags plus existing KF3_DIAG_REFRESH_STACK=1

workload_cutoff.method: nonce plus newly recorded cmd PID/StartTime identity, then native tree cutoff; no kill-by-name or old PID adoption
workload_cutoff.limits: confirmation marker follows process termination; not exact per-process exit times

observed_outcome.censoring: fixed diagnostic stopping rule and owned tree cutoff, not completed benchmark
observed_outcome.not_a_pass_oracle: wrapper/task result0 or CHILDREN_EXITED does not establish benchmark success
observed_outcome.event_query_basis: guest own saved launch UTC; guest approximately2h behind host

capture.limits: ETL stops before final cutoff; no exact stop instant, full-boot or complete-event coverage claim; no ETL decode

restoration.raw_status_limit: raw session status VM_RUNNING is prior phase; endline and restoration establish closure

image_identity_limit: top parent content/backchain metadata sealed; underlying base full content hash not captured
publication_scope: three metadata files only, no product fix, new run or experimental-runtime ancestry merge
